scoring_justification: Checker recomputes the total irreducible representation from public site contributions and occupancies, then compares agent's submitted coefficients within tolerance.

hidden_assets.purpose: Expected irreducible representation coefficients and total degrees of freedom
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Public crystallographic site data and occupancies from Table 1 column 4 of the paper; irreducible representations from Xia et al., Phys. Rev. B 55, 14892 (1997).
hidden_assets.generation_method: Checker computes the same linear combination of site irreps weighted by occupancies; the result is deterministic and matches Eq. (6) of the paper.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: The values are the unique solution of the group-theoretical algebra with the given occupancies, identical to the paper's reported result.

a1.description: Irreducible representation count for A1 (may be fractional)

b1.description: Irreducible representation count for B1 (may be fractional)

e.description: Irreducible representation count for E (may be fractional)

total_df.description: Total degrees of freedom, must equal 135

outputs.description: Total irreducible representation decomposition for the actual (Sr/Ba)₅Nb₁₀O₃₀ compound with partial occupancies.

output_contract.notes: This artifact reproduces Eq. (6) of the paper. The checker will recompute the decomposition independently and compare all coefficients within a floating‑point tolerance.
